output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is large, the 'balances[msg.sender] -= _value' operation can cause it to underflow and become very large, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is large, the 'balances[_from] -= _value' operation can cause it to underflow and become very large, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is large, it can cause the 'allowed[msg.sender][_spender]' assignment to overflow, allowing attackers to manipulate allowances.
The 'receiveApproval' function has an access control vulnerability. It allows any function to be called arbitrarily, due to the lack of protection, allowing attackers to exploit it.
